metadata.title: feat(infra): s390x wheel builder container and workflow
metadata.author: jonpspri

description:
## Summary

- Adds `infra/s390x/Containerfile` that builds native Python wheels from source for packages lacking pre-built s390x binaries on PyPI: cryptography, granian, setproctitle, jq, MarkupSafe, grpcio, psutil, brotli, httptools, uvloop, and argon2-cffi-bindings.
- Adds `.github/workflows/s390x-wheels.yml` — a manually-triggered workflow that builds and pushes the wheel container to `ghcr.io` so downstream Containerfile stages can `COPY --from` the pre-built wheels.
- Sets `GRPC_PYTHON_BUILD_SYSTEM_OPENSSL=True` for the grpcio build since s390x does not support BoringSSL.

## Test plan

- [ ] Trigger the workflow manually via Actions > "s390x Wheel Builder" > Run workflow
- [ ] Verify the image is pushed to `ghcr.io/ibm/mcp-context-forge-s390x-wheels`
- [ ] Verify wheels are present at `/wheels` inside the container

comments.author: Copilot
comments.body: `microdnf install` here is missing the size-reduction flags used elsewhere in the repo (e.g., `--nodocs --setopt=install_weak_deps=0`) and doesn’t remove `/var/cache/yum`. Without those, this wheel builder image will likely pull weak deps and retain RPM caches, making it larger than necessary. Consider aligning with the existing UBI10 minimal pattern: use `microdnf upgrade/install` with `--nodocs --setopt=install_weak_deps=0`, then `microdnf clean all` and `rm -rf /var/cache/yum`.

comments.author: Copilot
comments.body: The comments say this builds everything in a single layer “to keep the image small,” but the image will still include the full build toolchain layer plus pip’s download/build caches (e.g. under `/root/.cache/pip`). To actually keep the published wheel image small, consider (1) using `--no-cache-dir`/`PIP_NO_CACHE_DIR=1` and cleaning pip caches after the wheel build, and (2) using a multi-stage build where the final stage contains only `/wheels` (copy from the builder stage) and excludes compilers/rust/autotools.

commits.message:
feat(infra): add s390x wheel builder Containerfile and workflow

Pre-build native Python wheels for packages lacking s390x binaries
on PyPI (cryptography, granian, grpcio, etc.) so downstream container
builds can COPY them in rather than compiling from source each time.

Signed-off-by: Jonathan Springer <jps@s390x.com>
